# frozen_string_literal: true

# Links the taxpayer to an entity a sync found at Instead under the taxpayer's name, so a
# send files under the record the firm already keeps there rather than opening a second one.
class TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Instead::Clients::LinkEntityByName
  include KindOfService

  class TaxpayerLookupError < ServiceError; end

  # How the search ended, and the entity it links when it ended on exactly one.
  Match = Struct.new(:outcome, :entity)
  private_constant :Match

  # A name with punctuation dropped, spaces of any kind collapsed and case ignored — `Acme, L.L.C.` is `Acme LLC`,
  # `Acme Inc` is not. Applied to the column and to the name searched for alike.
  NORMALIZED_NAME_SQL = "lower(btrim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(%<value>s, '[\\u00a0\\u1680\\u2000-\\u200a\\u202f\\u205f\\u3000]', ' ', 'g'), '[^[:alnum:][:space:]]', '', 'g'), '[[:space:]]+', ' ', 'g')))"

  # Spellings of one legal form, as normalized words, to the one they read as — `Acme Incorporated` is `Acme Inc`.
  LEGAL_FORM_SPELLINGS = {'incorporated' => 'inc', 'corporation' => 'corp', 'company' => 'co', 'limited' => 'ltd', 'l l c' => 'llc', 'l l p' => 'llp'}.freeze

  # A business name that names nothing but its legal form — `,,, LLC` — names no business.
  LEGAL_FORMS = %w[inc corp co ltd llc llp lp pc pllc plc].freeze

  # The normalized name with `&` and `and` dropped and each legal form spelled one way —
  # `Smith & Sons`, `Smith and Sons` and `Smith Sons` are one name.
  NORMALIZED_BUSINESS_NAME_SQL = LEGAL_FORM_SPELLINGS.reduce(format(NORMALIZED_NAME_SQL, value: "regexp_replace(replace(%<value>s, '&', ' '), '\\mand\\M', ' ', 'gi')")) do |name_sql, (spelling, legal_form)|
    "regexp_replace(#{name_sql}, '\\m#{spelling}\\M', '#{legal_form}', 'g')"
  end

  attr_reader :user, :actor, :tax_preparation

  # @!method self.call(user, actor, tax_preparation)
  #   @param user [User] - required
  #   @param actor [Owner, Employee] - required
  #   @param tax_preparation [TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::TaxPreparation] - required
  #   @return [ServiceResult] success: [TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Instead::Entity, nil] —
  #     nil unless exactly one unlinked entity of the return type carries the taxpayer's name — a person's
  #     first and last name, or the account's name when the account holds no other contact — or, when none
  #     does, exactly one carries a person's first and last name swapped; nil also when CRM will not name
  #     the taxpayer
  def initialize(user, actor, tax_preparation)
    @user = user
    @actor = actor
    @tax_preparation = tax_preparation
  end

  private

  def perform
    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::ExportPolicy.authorize!(user, actor, :export)

    entity_type = TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Instead::Entity::ENTITY_TYPE_BY_RETURN_TYPE.fetch(tax_preparation.return_type)
    unlinked_entities = TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Instead::Entity.active.unlinked.where(firm_id: tax_preparation.firm_id, entity_type:)
    match = tax_preparation.business_return? ? match_business(unlinked_entities) : match_person(unlinked_entities)
    TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Metrics.emit_entity_match(:instead, match.outcome)
    return success if match.entity.blank?

    match.entity.update!(client_id: tax_preparation.client_id, contact_id: tax_preparation.contact_id)

    success(match.entity)
  rescue TaxpayerLookupError
    success
  end

  def match_business(unlinked_entities)
    business_name = names_business?(tax_preparation.business_name) ? tax_preparation.business_name : fetch_account_name!
    namesakes = list_by_business_name(unlinked_entities, business_name).limit(2).to_a

    build_match(namesakes, :matched, :namesakes)
  end

  # The account's name speaks for this contact only while the account holds no other one.
  def match_person(unlinked_entities)
    contact = fetch_contact!
    account_name = fetch_account_name! if sole_contact_of_account?
    namesakes = list_by_person_name(unlinked_entities, contact.first_name, contact.last_name, account_name).limit(2).to_a
    return build_match(namesakes, :matched, :namesakes) if namesakes.any? || contact.first_name.blank? || contact.last_name.blank?

    swapped_namesakes = list_by_first_and_last_name(unlinked_entities, contact.last_name, contact.first_name).limit(2).to_a
    return build_match(swapped_namesakes, :matched_swapped, :swapped_namesakes) if swapped_namesakes.any?

    Match.new(:no_match, nil)
  end

  def build_match(namesakes, single_outcome, several_outcome)
    return Match.new(:no_match, nil) if namesakes.empty?
    return Match.new(single_outcome, namesakes.first) if namesakes.one?

    Match.new(several_outcome, nil)
  end

  def list_by_person_name(unlinked_entities, first_name, last_name, account_name)
    namesakes_by_first_and_last_name = list_by_first_and_last_name(unlinked_entities, first_name, last_name) if first_name.present? && last_name.present?
    namesakes_by_account_name = list_by_whole_name(unlinked_entities, account_name) if account_name.present?
    namesakes_by_key = [namesakes_by_first_and_last_name, namesakes_by_account_name].compact
    return unlinked_entities.none if namesakes_by_key.empty?

    namesakes_by_key.reduce(:or)
  end

  def list_by_first_and_last_name(unlinked_entities, first_name, last_name)
    unlinked_entities.where("#{name_equals_sql('first_name')} AND #{name_equals_sql('last_name')}", first_name, first_name, last_name, last_name)
  end

  def list_by_whole_name(unlinked_entities, name)
    unlinked_entities.where(name_equals_sql('name'), name, name)
  end

  def list_by_business_name(unlinked_entities, business_name)
    unlinked_entities.where(name_equals_sql('name', NORMALIZED_BUSINESS_NAME_SQL), business_name, business_name)
  end

  # A searched name that normalizes to nothing matches nothing.
  def name_equals_sql(column, normalized_name_sql = NORMALIZED_NAME_SQL)
    searched_name_sql = format(normalized_name_sql, value: '?')

    "(#{format(normalized_name_sql, value: column)} = #{searched_name_sql} AND #{searched_name_sql} <> '')"
  end

  # Read through the same normalization the search runs, so `L. L. C.` and `Incorporated` name no business either.
  def names_business?(business_name)
    normalized_name_sql = ActiveRecord::Base.sanitize_sql_array(["SELECT #{format(NORMALIZED_BUSINESS_NAME_SQL, value: '?')}", business_name.to_s])
    normalized_name = ActiveRecord::Base.connection.select_value(normalized_name_sql)

    (normalized_name.split - LEGAL_FORMS).any?
  end

  def sole_contact_of_account?
    result = Crm::Api::Contact.list_by_account(firm: actor.firm, user:, actor:, account_id: tax_preparation.client_id)

    result.data.contacts.one?
  end

  def fetch_contact!
    result = Crm::Api::Contact.find(firm: actor.firm, user:, actor:, contact_id: tax_preparation.contact_id)
    raise TaxpayerLookupError, result.errors if result.failure?

    result.data
  end

  def fetch_account_name!
    result = Crm::Api::Account.find(firm: actor.firm, user:, actor:, account_id: tax_preparation.client_id)
    raise TaxpayerLookupError, result.errors if result.failure?

    result.data.account_name
  end
end
